newsitem.title: UK: UK PMI services index to start on April 3.
newsitem.headline: UK PMI services index to start on April 3.

text.p: The Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply (CIPS) said it would start publishing a new purchasing managers' index for the British services sector on April 3.
It will be released on the third working day of each month from that date.
"The new report will be the first to measure, on a regular monthly basis, activity in UK service industries, which account for around 60 percent of the economy," the CIPS said.

It will cover all service sectors, apart from retail and wholesale and will track: levels of business activity, levels of new business, levels of outstanding business, average prices charged, average operating costs and employment.
The report will be released exclusively on Reuters at 0930 GMT and then made generally available at 1000 GMT.
